facts.question: How many players per team are on court in kabaddi?
facts.statement: Kabaddi is played with 7 players per team on court.
facts.explanation: Each side has seven players on court at a time.

facts.question: Which team won the inaugural Pro Kabaddi League season?
facts.statement: Jaipur Pink Panthers won the inaugural Pro Kabaddi League season.
facts.explanation: Jaipur took the first Pro Kabaddi title in 2014.

facts.question: In which country did kabaddi originate?
facts.explanation: The sport has its roots in ancient India.

facts.question: How many minutes long is a standard kabaddi match?
facts.statement: A standard kabaddi match lasts 40 minutes, split into two halves.
facts.explanation: Two 20-minute halves are separated by a five-minute break.

facts.question: In which year did the Pro Kabaddi League begin?
facts.statement: The Pro Kabaddi League began in 2014.
facts.explanation: The league's launch turned kabaddi into one of India's most-watched televised sports.

facts.question: Which team won three consecutive Pro Kabaddi League titles?
facts.statement: Patna Pirates won three consecutive Pro Kabaddi League titles.
facts.explanation: Patna took seasons 3, 4 and 5, the only PKL three-peat so far.

facts.question: How many seconds does a raider have to complete a raid in kabaddi?
facts.statement: A raider has 30 seconds to complete a raid in kabaddi.
facts.explanation: Exceeding the raid clock hands the point to the defending side.

facts.question: Which country won the first Kabaddi World Cup in 2004?
facts.statement: India won the first Kabaddi World Cup in 2004.
facts.explanation: India beat Iran in the final in Mumbai and went on to win every edition through 2016.
